scope.cap_semantics: INCOMPLETE; exact completed/partial/unexamined roots; partial paths are never solutions
scope.endpoint_initial_states: boundary plus every proper codeword-prefix state
scope.endpoint_terminal_rule: boundary state is present in determinized state-set
scope.iv_model: every arbitrary original 8-byte IV through all observation-compatible C[0:8] registers (4096 or 256 by map)
scope.retention: every completed-root terminal full-ciphertext/plaintext-suffix completion, including those retained before a later cap; no scoring or beam pruning
